messages.subject: Work group tomorrow: 10-noon
parts:
Hi there friends,

This is your friendly reminder that D-RUG will be meeting tomorrow (Wed 3 Nov) from 10 to noon in the Data Lab classroom and on zoom. Please remember to post questions in advance on our Discourse site if you are planning to attend remotely. Relevant links below.

Can't wait to see you tomorrow!

Best wishes,
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators





The fall quaRter is upon us, which means we have a whole academic term of Davis R Users' Group (D-RUG) to look forward to. This quarter, D-RUG will be meeting from 10am-noon on Wednesdays. We will be meeting in a hybrid format, in 360 Shields Library (DataLab classroom) and on Zoom. You are cordially invited to attend in either venue.

This year, we are adopting a new queueing approach for virtual folks seeking help at D-RUG. If you are joining virtually, we ask that you submit your question to our Discourse site in advance of our meetings, and we will address folks' questions in the order they are received. Of course, you are always welcome (and encouraged) to just come hang out, and use the work group time as a dedicated chunk of time to get some coding done with good company.

For those not familiar with D-RUG, the R Users' Group is a weekly working group to get some help with R-specific coding problems. The coordinators are various and sundry coding connoisseurs, ranging from UCD data scientists to grad students on campus. We meet for 2 hours in an open-forum format, so you can treat D-RUG as a communal, co-working environment: come hang out and chat, work on your own, seek help, make friends. Or, a little bit of everything! Check out our website for more information.

We are also seeking presenters! It is nice to mix things up with occasional presentations. In the past, we've had (15- to 45-minute) presentations ranging from data types, to tidyverse tools, to spatial data, to the Google Earth Engine plugin for R. If you would like to hone your teaching, need an excuse to perfect your cRaft, or want to show off a cool R trick you learned, shoot us an email and we can add your presentation to our calendar! Presentations can be in-person or virtual (and in-person presentations will be streamed for virtual attendees).

messages.author: 2937cefa7be1be8e
messages.subject: GSR job in "Digital Communications" at UC Davis DataLab
parts:
Hi useRs,

 

Our amazing GSR at DataLab has been awarded an extramural fellowship and will be leaving us at the end of this quarter. So, we have a job opening! If you are a graduate student at UC Davis looking for a position I hope you will consider applying, and/or help spread the word about this opportunity. Details and full job description link below.

 

Wishing you a restful Thanksgiving holiday!

 

-

UC Davis DataLab is hiring a GSR in Digital Communications for winter-spring 2022, with possibility of extension into the 2022-2023 academic year. This position requires very strong writing and communication skills, basic familiarity with R, comfort using or learning web platforms (primarily Wordpress); web programming skills and past interdisciplinary research experience are a plus. Students from any graduate group/program are eligible to apply.

 

Full details and how to apply:   https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/2021/11/10/gsr-digital-comms-2022/

 

Applications are being reviewing as they are received, so we encourage prospective applicants to submit their materials as soon as possible. 

 

--

Pamela L. Reynolds, PhD

Associate Director

DataLab: Data Science and Informatics

University of California, Davis

plrey...@ucdavis.edu
https://datalab.ucdavis.edu
